5 Days 4 Nights Serengeti Ngorongoro Safari

Package overview

Experience the magic of Tanzania on this unforgettable journey through two of Africa’s most iconic wildlife destinations— . This 5-day safari offers a perfect blend of vast open plains, rich wildlife encounters, and dramatic landscapes, making it ideal for both first-time visitors and seasoned safari enthusiasts.

From the endless savannahs of the Serengeti, famous for the Great Wildebeest Migration and abundant predators, to the wildlife-dense Ngorongoro Crater—often referred to as Africa’s “Garden of Eden”—this safari promises exceptional game viewing at every turn. Expect close encounters with the Big Five, stunning scenery, and authentic African wilderness experiences, all guided by professional safari experts.

  • Explore the legendary Serengeti National Park plains
  • Experience the wildlife-rich Ngorongoro Crater
  • Chance to witness the Great Wildebeest Migration (seasonal)
  • Big Five game viewing opportunities
  • Scenic landscapes of northern Tanzania

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Arusha – Serengeti National Park

Your adventure begins with an early morning departure from Arusha. Enjoy a scenic drive through the Great Rift Valley and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area en route to the world-famous Serengeti National Park . Arrive in time for lunch at your lodge or camp, followed by an afternoon game drive across the vast plains of the Serengeti—home to lions, elephants, giraffes, and (seasonally) the Great Wildebeest Migration. Overnight: Serengeti (lodge or tented camp) Lunch & Dinner

02Day 2 | Full Day in Serengeti National Park

Spend a full day exploring the endless savannah of Serengeti National Park with morning and afternoon game drives. This park is renowned for: Large predator populations (lions, cheetahs, leopards) Massive herds of wildebeest and zebras Stunning landscapes and sunsets Optional: Hot air balloon safari at sunrise (extra cost). Overnight: Serengeti Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

03Day 3 | Serengeti – Ngorongoro Conservation Area

After breakfast, enjoy a final morning game drive in the Serengeti before heading toward the Ngorongoro Conservation Area . Arrive at the crater rim with breathtaking views of the world’s largest intact volcanic caldera. Overnight: Ngorongoro (crater rim lodge or nearby Karatu) Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

04Day 4 | Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive

Descend early into the Ngorongoro Crater for a half-day game drive. The crater offers one of the best wildlife viewing experiences in Africa, with a high chance of spotting: The Big Five (lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, rhino) Flamingos at Lake Magadi Dense wildlife concentration in a compact area Picnic lunch inside the crater before ascending in the afternoon. Overnight: Ngorongoro / Karatu Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

05Day 5 | Ngorongoro – Arusha

After breakfast, drive back to Arusha with optional cultural stops or local market visits along the way. Drop-off at your hotel or airport. Breakfast

  • Travel insurance or international medical cover
